name: selfh.st/icons
about: selfh.st/icons is a free, open-source icon set with 7,211 icons designed by selfh.st. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

faqs.a: Yes. All 7,211 selfh.st/icons are open source under the CC BY 4.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY 4.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use selfh.st/icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.
There are 7,211 icons in the selfh.st/icons set, designed by selfh.st. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of selfh.st/icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are selfh.st/icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
